name: Grand Mason Marblesten
summary: In Ironforge's Commons, Grand Mason Marblesten prepares a tribute to Sully Balloo. King Magni Bronzebeard commissioned the memorial for the dwarven soldier, who died in the Thandol Span tragedy, and Marblesten seeks stone worthy of the work.

sections.title: Master of the Stone
sections.body: Grand Mason Marblesten oversees civic projects and memorials in Ironforge's Commons. Dwarven stonemasons carve halls, pillars, and great effigies from the mountain, carrying on a tradition centuries old. Marblesten is among the city's foremost masters of the chisel, shaping stone to preserve the history of the Bronzebeard line.

sections.title: A King's Tribute
sections.body: King Magni commissioned Marblesten to build a memorial to Sully Balloo, a soldier who died in the Thandol Span tragedy. The memorial honors Balloo and his grieving widow. For a lasting tribute, Marblesten seeks Alterac Granite, one of the finest stones available, from Darrow Hill in Hillsbrad.

faq.answer: Grand Mason Marblesten is a senior dwarven stonemason in Ironforge's Commons. He oversees civic and royal sculpting projects, including the memorial to Sully Balloo commissioned by King Magni Bronzebeard.

faq.q: Where can I find Grand Mason Marblesten?
faq.answer: You can find Grand Mason Marblesten in the Commons district of Ironforge, among stone blocks and architectural works near the city's shops and banks.

faq.q: What monument is Marblesten working on?
faq.answer: Marblesten is building a memorial to Sully Balloo, a dwarven soldier who died in the Thandol Span tragedy. King Magni Bronzebeard commissioned it to honor Balloo and his grieving widow.

faq.q: Why does Marblesten need adventurers to gather materials?
faq.answer: Marblesten seeks one of the finest stones for a lasting memorial. He sends travelers to Darrow Hill in Hillsbrad to gather Alterac Granite.

faq.q: What does the title 'Grand Mason' mean in dwarven society?
faq.answer: Among dwarves, a Grand Mason is a master of stonecraft trusted with major state projects, royal architectural designs, and ceremonial memorials. Stoneworking is revered alongside blacksmithing.

faq.q: Is Marblesten an Alliance official or a private contractor?
faq.answer: Marblesten works within Ironforge for the kingdom and the Alliance. He coordinates with King Magni Bronzebeard's court on royal commissions.

angles.text: For dwarves, stonecraft is an ancestral heritage. Helping Marblesten honors the craft of Khaz Modan and the memory of Sully Balloo.
Miners who work the rock of Dun Morogh and beyond will know the care Marblesten gives to the quality of raw stone.
For the Alliance, Sully Balloo's sacrifice recalls the soldiers lost in its wars.
